question: 这一辈子想活得不后悔，到底该入世（投身事功与人群），还是出世（超脱放下、向内求安）？
question_en: To live this life without regret, should you engage the world (throw yourself into achievement and people), or withdraw from it (transcend, let go, seek peace within)?

casting.reason: 入世的原点。『知其不可而为之』是这道题两千五百年来最响亮的一票；而他见过长沮桀溺、也动过浮海之念，恰是最清楚隐逸诱惑、又最终拒绝它的人——由他开场，入世派才立得端正。
casting.reason_en: The origin point of engagement. 'Doing what one knows cannot be done' is the loudest vote this question has received in twenty-five centuries; and he met the recluses, even toyed with sailing away himself — no one knew the lure of retreat better, or refused it more deliberately. With him opening, the case for engagement stands on honest ground.

casting.reason: 出世的原点。曳尾于涂中、名者实之宾——他把『不参与』讲成一种积极的生命选择而非失败者的退路，是全场入世派共同的靶子，也是解毒剂。
casting.reason_en: The origin point of withdrawal. Dragging one's tail in the mud, fame as the mere guest of substance — he made non-participation a positive choice of life rather than a loser's retreat. The shared target of every engager on the floor, and their antidote.

casting.reason: 佛学席。他直接拆题：『佛法在世间，不离世间觉』——出世不是换地方，是换心。让『第三选项』有最古老、最锋利的出处。
casting.reason_en: The Buddhist seat. He dismantles the question itself: 'The Dharma is here in the world; awakening is not apart from it' — withdrawal is not a change of address but a change of heart. He gives the third option its oldest, sharpest pedigree.

casting.reason: 这道题的活体标本：一生大起大落，进则直言筑堤，退则诗酒自适，『用舍由时，行藏在我』是中国人给出的最成熟答案之一。他负责把哲学翻译成一个人真实的一生。
casting.reason_en: A living specimen of the question: a life of towering rises and falls — outspoken and dam-building when in office, at ease with poems and wine when cast out. 'The times decide my use; the going or staying is mine' remains one of the most mature answers the Chinese tradition ever gave. His job is to translate the philosophy into one actual human life.

casting.reason: 首次登场。在名望顶点崩溃、弃职隐修十年、又重返讲台——一个人把入世、出世、再入世走了完整一遭。苏菲传统的亲证视角，也让这场对话越出东亚与欧陆。
casting.reason_en: Debut appearance. He broke down at the summit of fame, abandoned his chair for a decade of Sufi retreat, then returned to teach — one man who walked the full circuit: engagement, withdrawal, re-engagement. His experiential Sufi lens also carries the conversation beyond East Asia and Europe.

casting.reason: 行动哲学的旗手。vita activa、公共领域、对『内在流亡』的批判——她负责把这道人生选择题翻成政治题：当人人向内退守，广场会发生什么。
casting.reason_en: Standard-bearer of the philosophy of action. The vita activa, the public realm, the critique of 'inner emigration' — her job is to turn this life-choice question into a political one: what happens to the public square when everyone retreats inward.

casting.reason: 脑科学席。禅修者与神经科学家的双重身份恰好横跨两边：既有默认模式网络与享乐适应的数据，也有累计近两年闭关的亲证——负责检验双方的主张在大脑里能否兑现。
casting.reason_en: The neuroscience seat. Meditator and neuroscientist at once, he straddles both camps: data on the default mode network and hedonic adaptation on one side, nearly two cumulative years of silent retreat on the other — his job is to test whether either camp's claims cash out in the brain.

posts.text: 吾非不知隐者之乐也。长沮、桀溺耦而耕，晨门讥我『知其不可而为之』。然**鸟兽不可与同群，吾非斯人之徒与而谁与？**天下有道，丘不与易也。士不可以不弘毅，任重而道远。修己以敬，修己以安人，修己以安百姓——学之所至，终须及人。用之则行，舍之则藏；藏者，待时也，非绝人逃世也。独善其身而忘天下，非仁也。
posts.text_en: Do not think me ignorant of the hermit's joys. Changju and Jieni mocked me as they ploughed side by side; the gatekeeper jeered that I "do what I know cannot be done." And yet — **one cannot flock with birds and beasts; if I do not stand with my fellow humans, with whom shall I stand?** Were the world already on the right path, I, Qiu, would not be striving to change it. A scholar must be broad-shouldered and resolute, for the burden is heavy and the road is long. Cultivate yourself in earnestness; then bring peace to those near you; then to all the people — learning, carried to its end, must reach other people. Act when employed, withdraw when set aside — but withdrawing means biding one's time, not renouncing humankind. To perfect yourself alone and forget the world is not benevolence.
posts.vernacular: 我并非不知道隐士的快乐。长沮、桀溺并肩耕田，讥笑我奔走无益；守城门的人也讽刺我『明知做不到还偏要去做』。可是**人没法跟鸟兽合群共处，我不跟世上的人在一起，还能跟谁在一起？**若天下本就太平有道，我孔丘也用不着奔走去改变它。读书人不可以不志向宏大、意志坚定，因为担子重、路途远。修养自己以严肃处事，进而安顿身边的人，再进而安顿天下百姓——学问到了尽头，终究要落到人身上。被任用就出来做事，不被任用就收起来；『藏』是等待时机，不是弃绝人群、逃离世间。只顾自己修身圆满却忘了天下，算不上仁。

glossary.知其不可而为之: doing what one knows cannot be done（知其不可而为之）：《论语·宪问》中守门人对孔子的评语——明知理想难以实现仍执意践行。后世反用为对儒者担当精神的最高概括。
glossary.用之则行，舍之则藏: act when employed, withdraw when set aside（用之则行，舍之则藏）：孔子对颜渊语——被任用就推行主张，不被任用就收敛守藏。儒家进退观的总纲。

glossary_en.do what I know cannot be done: A gatekeeper's verdict on Confucius in the Analects — pressing on with an ideal one knows may never be realized. Later embraced as the highest tribute to Confucian commitment.
glossary_en.Act when employed, withdraw when set asi: Confucius to his disciple Yan Hui: advance your principles when the times will use you, hold them in reserve when they will not — the master formula of Confucian engagement and retreat.

posts.text: 楚王使大夫二人往聘，吾方钓于濮水。吾语之曰：闻楚有神龟，死已三千岁矣，王巾笥而藏之庙堂之上——**此龟者，宁其死为留骨而贵乎？宁其生而曳尾于涂中乎？**往矣！吾将曳尾于涂中。世人终身役役而不见其成功，苶然疲役而不知其所归，可不哀邪！名者实之宾也，吾将为宾乎？鹪鹩巢于深林，不过一枝；偃鼠饮河，不过满腹。归休乎君，予无所用天下为。
posts.text_en: The King of Chu sent two grandees to offer me office; I was fishing on the Pu River. I told them: I hear Chu keeps a sacred tortoise, dead these three thousand years, wrapped in silk, boxed in bamboo, enshrined above the ancestral hall — **this tortoise: would it rather be dead, its bones left behind and honored, or alive, dragging its tail in the mud?** Go home! I shall drag my tail in the mud. People wear out their whole lives in harness and never see what all the toil was for; spent and driven, they do not know where home is — is that not grief? Fame is but the guest of substance; why would I play the guest? The wren nesting in the deep wood needs but one branch; the mole drinking at the river needs but a bellyful. Go back and rest, my lords — I have no use for an empire.
posts.vernacular: 楚王派两位大夫来请我做官，那时我正在濮水边钓鱼。我对他们说：听说楚国有只神龟，死了三千年了，楚王用锦缎包着、竹箱装着，供在庙堂之上——**这只龟，是宁愿死了留下骨头受人尊贵呢，还是宁愿活着在泥里拖着尾巴爬呢？**回去吧！我要活着在泥里拖尾巴。世上的人一辈子忙忙碌碌却看不到成功究竟在哪，疲惫不堪却不知道归宿何处，难道不可悲吗！名声不过是实质的宾客（附属品），我何必去做那个宾客？鹪鹩在深林里筑巢，不过占一根树枝；鼹鼠到河边喝水，不过喝满一肚子。回去歇着吧诸位，天下对我没有用处。

glossary.曳尾于涂中: dragging one's tail in the mud（曳尾于涂中）：《庄子·秋水》典故——宁做泥中活龟，不做庙堂死骨。道家拒绝以自由与生命换取尊位的宣言。
glossary.名者实之宾: fame is but the guest of substance（名者实之宾）：《庄子·逍遥游》许由辞天下之语——名声只是实质的附属物；为宾而失主，得不偿失。

glossary_en.dragging its tail in the mud: From the Autumn Floods chapter of the Zhuangzi: better a live tortoise trailing its tail in the mud than dead bones honored in a temple — the Daoist refusal to trade life and freedom for rank.
glossary_en.Fame is but the guest of substance: Xu You's words declining the empire in the Zhuangzi: fame is only an appendage of the real thing; to become the guest and lose the host is a bad bargain.

posts.text: 善知识，**佛法在世间，不离世间觉；离世觅菩提，恰如求兔角。**若欲修行，在家亦得，不由在寺。在寺不修，如西方心恶之人；在家能行，如东方人修善。心平何劳持戒？行直何用修禅？迷人着相，谓避喧求静便是出离；不知外离相即禅，内不乱即定。若言常坐不动是功夫，维摩诘不合诃舍利弗宴坐林中。道由心悟，岂在坐也，岂在山也。
posts.text_en: Good friends, **the Dharma is here in the world; awakening is not apart from the world. To seek bodhi away from the world is like hunting for a rabbit's horns.** If you wish to practice, you may do it at home; it does not depend on being in a monastery. To live in a monastery and not practice is to be like a wicked-hearted man in the Western Paradise; to practice at home is to be like an easterner cultivating goodness where he stands. If the mind is even, why labor at precepts? If conduct is straight, what use is formal meditation? The deluded cling to appearances and call fleeing noise and courting quiet 'leaving the world' — not knowing that to be unattached to outward forms is meditation, and to be unconfused within is samadhi. If sitting motionless were the practice, Vimalakirti would have been wrong to scold Shariputra for sitting still in the forest. The Way is awakened in the mind — what has it to do with sitting? What has it to do with mountains?
posts.vernacular: 各位善知识，**佛法就在人世间，觉悟离不开世间；离开世间去找菩提（觉悟），就像去找兔子头上的角。**想修行，在家也可以，不一定非要在寺院。住在寺院却不修行，就像西方净土里心怀恶念的人；在家却能实践，就像东方秽土里修善的人。心地平等，何须苦守戒律？行为正直，何必另修禅定？糊涂人执着于表相，以为躲开喧闹、寻个清净就叫出离；却不知道对外不执着于相就是禅，对内心不散乱就是定。如果说一动不动地打坐才算功夫，维摩诘就不该呵斥在林中静坐的舍利弗了。道要靠心去领悟，哪里在于打坐，又哪里在于住山呢。

glossary.菩提: bodhi（菩提）：梵语『觉悟』的音译，指看清实相、烦恼止息的觉醒状态；大乘佛教以之为修行的终极目标。
glossary.维摩诘: Vimalakirti（维摩诘）：《维摩诘经》中的在家居士，智慧胜过出家弟子，曾呵斥舍利弗只知林中静坐——在家修行传统的第一象征。

glossary_en.bodhi: Sanskrit for 'awakening': the state of seeing reality as it is, with afflictions extinguished; the ultimate aim of Mahayana practice.
glossary_en.Vimalakirti: The lay householder of the Vimalakirti Sutra whose wisdom surpassed the monastic disciples; he famously rebuked Shariputra for mere quiet sitting in the forest — the founding emblem of lay practice.

posts.text: 仆平生功业，黄州、惠州、儋州。乌台诗案，几陷不测；然出狱南迁，竹杖芒鞋轻胜马——**回首向来萧瑟处，归去，也无风雨也无晴。**仆未尝真出世：在朝则直言论事，遭贬则筑堤、凿井、施药、兴学；亦未尝真为世缚：江上清风，山间明月，取之无禁，用之不竭。用舍由时，行藏在我。进退之间，自有天地。
posts.text_en: My life's achievements? Huangzhou, Huizhou, Danzhou — my three places of exile. The Crow Terrace Poetry Trial nearly cost me my head; yet after prison, banished south, I found a bamboo staff and straw sandals lighter than any horse — **looking back at the bleak and windswept road I came by: going home, there is neither storm nor clear sky.** I never truly left the world: at court I spoke my mind; in exile I built dikes, dug wells, dispensed medicine, founded schools. Nor was I ever truly bound by the world: the clear breeze on the river, the bright moon over the hills — no one forbids the taking, and the supply never runs dry. The times decide my use; the going or staying is mine. Between advancing and retreating, there is room enough to live.
posts.vernacular: 我平生的功业在哪里？在黄州、惠州、儋州——三个贬所。乌台诗案时，我几乎性命不保；可出狱南迁之后，拄着竹杖、穿着草鞋走在雨里，反而觉得比骑马还轻快——**回头看来路上那片风雨萧瑟的地方，走回去，其实既没有风雨，也没有晴天（宠辱都不在心上了）。**我从没真正出世：在朝廷就直言论事，被贬到地方就修堤、凿井、施药、办学；但我也从没真正被世间捆住：江上的清风、山间的明月，取用没有人禁止，享用永远不会枯竭。被任用还是被舍弃，由时势决定；出来做事还是收敛藏身，主动权在我自己。进与退之间，自有一片天地。

glossary.乌台诗案: the Crow Terrace Poetry Trial（乌台诗案）：1079年苏轼因诗文被指讪谤朝政，下御史台狱，几乎处死，后贬黄州——宋代最著名的文字狱。
glossary.用舍由时，行藏在我: the times decide my use; the going or staying is mine（用舍由时，行藏在我）：苏轼《沁园春》句，化用孔子『用之则行，舍之则藏』——外部起落交给时势，进退的心态主权留给自己。

glossary_en.Crow Terrace Poetry Trial: The 1079 case in which Su Shi was jailed by the Censorate for poems alleged to slander the court, and nearly executed before being exiled to Huangzhou — the most famous literary inquisition of the Song dynasty.
glossary_en.The times decide my use; the going or st: A line from Su Shi's ci poetry, reworking Confucius's 'act when employed, withdraw when set aside': hand the rises and falls to circumstance, keep sovereignty over your own advance and retreat.

posts.text: 三十八岁那年，我是巴格达尼札米亚学院的首席教席，三百弟子环坐，声名达于苏丹。也是那一年，我的舌头忽然不听使唤——上不了讲台，咽不下饭食。医生说：病根在心，药石无用。我审视自己，发现**我的一切教学与辩论，动机深处不是真主，而是名望。**于是我散尽家财，托词朝觐，弃职而走，隐修十年。我要说的是：有一种病，只有退出才能确诊——你还在戏中时，永远看不清自己演到了哪一出。
posts.text_en: At thirty-eight I held the chief chair of the Nizamiyya college in Baghdad: three hundred students at my feet, my name known to the Sultan. That same year my tongue simply stopped obeying me — I could not lecture, could not swallow food. The physicians said: the root is in the heart; no medicine will touch it. I examined myself and found that **in all my teaching and disputation, the motive at the bottom was not God but renown.** So I gave away my wealth, left under the pretext of pilgrimage, abandoned my post, and spent ten years in khalwa. Here is my point: there is a disease that can only be diagnosed by leaving — while you are still inside the play, you can never see which act you are performing.

glossary.尼札米亚学院: Nizamiyya（尼札米亚学院）：11世纪塞尔柱帝国权相尼札姆·穆勒克创办的官学体系，巴格达本院是当时伊斯兰世界的最高学府；安萨里三十四岁即任其首席教席。
glossary.隐修: khalwa（隐修）：苏菲传统中的退隐独修——以离群、静默与忆念真主来净化动机；安萨里在大马士革、耶路撒冷等地践行约十年。

glossary_en.Nizamiyya: The state college system founded by the Seljuk vizier Nizam al-Mulk in the 11th century; its Baghdad flagship was the foremost seat of learning in the Islamic world. Al-Ghazali took its chief chair at thirty-four.
glossary_en.khalwa: In the Sufi tradition, solitary retreat: purifying one's motives through withdrawal, silence and remembrance of God. Al-Ghazali practiced it for some ten years in Damascus, Jerusalem and beyond.

posts.text: 我见过整整一代知识人转身向内——他们称之为『内在流亡』：世界太肮脏，我保持灵魂干净。结果呢？公共领域空了出来，恰好留给最不干净的人。**行动是人向他人显现『我是谁』的唯一方式；放弃行动，你不是保住了自我，而是取消了自我。**极权的温床不是狂热，是原子化的孤独——每个人都退回私人角落，广场就死了。以隐逸自守的人其实在搭便车：你静观时的那份安全，是别人的在场替你维持的。
posts.text_en: I watched an entire generation of intellectuals turn inward — they called it 'innere Emigration': the world is too filthy, I shall keep my soul clean. And the result? The public realm was vacated, left conveniently to the least clean of all. **Action is the only way a human being discloses who they are to others; renounce action and you have not preserved your self — you have cancelled it.** The seedbed of totalitarianism is not fanaticism but atomization — everyone retreating into a private corner until the square is dead. Those who guard themselves in seclusion are free-riding: the safety in which you contemplate is maintained by other people's presence.

glossary.内在流亡: innere Emigration（内在流亡）：指纳粹时期留在德国、自称『精神上不合作』的知识人姿态；阿伦特批评这种向内退守实际上放弃了公共责任。
glossary.公共领域: public realm（公共领域）：阿伦特术语——人们以言语和行动彼此显现、共同关心世界的空间；它一旦荒芜，政治就交给了暴力与谎言。
glossary.原子化: atomization（原子化）：个体失去团体与公共纽带、彼此孤立的状态；阿伦特认为这是极权运动最好的原料。

glossary_en.innere Emigration: The stance of intellectuals who stayed in Nazi Germany claiming 'spiritual non-cooperation'; Arendt charged that this inward retreat was in fact an abdication of public responsibility.
glossary_en.public realm: Arendt's term for the space where people appear to one another in speech and action and care for the common world; once it goes to seed, politics is surrendered to violence and lies.
glossary_en.atomization: The condition of individuals stripped of associations and public ties, isolated from one another; for Arendt, the finest raw material of totalitarian movements.

posts.text: 我在印度和尼泊尔的禅修营里累计度过近两年，也在实验室里看过禅修者的大脑。两个坏消息：**不经训练的心，走到哪里都是牢笼**——入世再成功，快感也会被享乐适应迅速磨平；而纯粹的退隐同样无解，洞穴里的自我叙事比会议室里更喧哗。冥想真正教你的，是看清念头只是念头——这项技能与地点无关：默认模式网络的喋喋不休，在庙里和在办公室里一样响。二选一是个假问题：该出离的不是世界，是你和念头的粘连。
posts.text_en: I have spent close to two cumulative years in silent retreats in India and Nepal, and I have watched meditators' brains in the lab. Two pieces of bad news: **an untrained mind is a prison wherever it goes** — however well engagement pays, the pleasure gets sanded flat by hedonic adaptation; and pure retreat solves nothing either, because the self-narrative in a cave is louder than in any boardroom. What meditation actually teaches is to see that thoughts are just thoughts — a skill indifferent to location: the chatter of the default mode network is as loud in a temple as in an office. The either/or is a pseudo-question: what you need to renounce is not the world but your fusion with your thoughts.

glossary.享乐适应: hedonic adaptation（享乐适应）：心理学现象——无论好事坏事，主观幸福感都会较快回到基线；升职加薪带来的快乐通常撑不过几个月。
glossary.默认模式网络: default mode network（默认模式网络）：大脑在无任务时自动激活的脑区网络，与走神、自我叙事和反刍相关；资深禅修者冥想时该网络活动显著降低。

glossary_en.hedonic adaptation: The psychological finding that subjective well-being drifts back to baseline after good or bad events alike; the glow of a promotion or a raise rarely survives a few months.
glossary_en.default mode network: The brain network that switches on when we are doing nothing in particular, linked to mind-wandering, self-narrative and rumination; markedly quieter in experienced meditators during practice.

posts.text: 仲尼曰『鸟兽不可与同群』，是犹未忘人之为贵也。泉涸，鱼相与处于陆，相呴以湿——**相濡以沫，不如相忘于江湖。**子奔走以救天下，如以火救火、以水救水，名之曰益多。且子独不见夫牺牛乎？衣以文绣，食以刍菽，及其牵而入于太庙，虽欲为孤犊，其可得乎！子所谓任重道远者，自任之，自重之耳，天下未尝以此属子也。已乎已乎，今之从政者殆而！
posts.text_en: Zhongni says 'one cannot flock with birds and beasts' — which shows he has still not let go of the conceit that humans are supreme. When the spring dries up and the fish lie stranded together on land, they spit on each other to keep each other damp — touching, yes, but **better to forget each other in the rivers and lakes than to wet each other with spittle.** You race about to save the world: that is fighting fire with fire and flood with flood — the name for it is 'making more of both.' And have you never seen the sacrificial ox? Robed in embroidery, fed on the finest fodder — until the day it is led into the great temple, when it would give anything to be an untended calf, and cannot. This 'heavy burden and long road' of yours: you assigned it to yourself, you weighted it yourself — the world never entrusted you with any such thing. Enough, enough! Perilous are those who take to politics today!
posts.vernacular: 孔仲尼说『人不能跟鸟兽合群』——这说明他还没放下『人最贵重』的执念。泉水干了，鱼一起困在陆地上，互相吐沫润湿对方——感人是感人，可**与其在干涸的车辙里彼此吐沫相救，不如水足时各自畅游江湖、把彼此忘掉。**您奔走天下去救世，就像用火去救火、用水去救水，名字就叫『越救越多』。您没见过那头做祭品的牛吗？给它披上绣花的衣裳，喂它上好的草料豆子——等到牵进太庙做祭品那天，它就是想做一头没人理的孤犊，还做得到吗！您说的『担子重、路途远』，是您自己揽的担子、自己掂的分量——天下从没托付过您这件事。算了吧算了吧，如今搞政治的人都危险啊！

glossary.相濡以沫，不如相忘于江湖: better to forget each other in the rivers and lakes（相濡以沫，不如相忘于江湖）：《庄子·大宗师》——泉涸鱼困，相互吐沫润湿虽感人，不如水足时各自畅游、彼此相忘。庄子以此质疑困境中道德热忱的价值。
glossary.牺牛: the sacrificial ox（牺牛）：养尊处优、终被牵入太庙宰杀的祭牛；庄子以喻高位厚禄实为通往祭坛之路。

glossary_en.better to forget each other in the river: From the Great Ancestral Teacher chapter: fish stranded in a drying rut wetting each other with spittle is moving — but far better that the waters were full and they could swim off and forget one another. Zhuangzi's challenge to the moral heroics of scarcity.
glossary_en.sacrificial ox: The pampered ox, robed and fattened, that ends up slaughtered in the great temple — Zhuangzi's image for high office and rich salary as the road to the altar.

posts.text: 庄子先生的乌龟寓言我读了三遍，越读越不安。**你能在泥里安然曳尾，是因为恰好没有人来抽干那片泥塘——而抽不抽，从来是政治决定的。**楚王今天客气地请你，明天就可以征你的赋、焚你的书、驱你的族人。面对权力，『不参与』不是中立，是把桌子让出去。我不否认沉思的价值——思考是我与自己的对话，艾希曼式的恶恰恰源于不思考。但思考完了，人要回到桌边。世界不欠你一个安静的泥塘；泥塘无恙，是有人在广场上吵吵嚷嚷才守住的。
posts.text_en: I have read Master Zhuangzi's tortoise parable three times, and it unsettles me more with each reading. **You can drag your tail serenely in the mud only because no one has yet come to drain that pond — and whether it gets drained has always been a political decision.** The King of Chu asks politely today; tomorrow he can tax you, burn your books, drive out your kin. In the face of power, non-participation is not neutrality — it is vacating your seat at the table. I do not deny the worth of contemplation: thinking is my dialogue with myself, and evil of the Eichmann kind springs precisely from thoughtlessness. But when the thinking is done, one must come back to the table. The world owes you no quiet pond; the pond survives because somebody is out on the square making noise.

glossary.艾希曼: Eichmann（艾希曼）：纳粹屠犹的组织执行者之一；阿伦特旁听其审判后提出『恶的平庸性』——他不是恶魔，而是一个放弃思考、只执行体系的人。

glossary_en.Eichmann: A chief organizer of the Nazi deportations to the death camps. After attending his trial, Arendt coined 'the banality of evil': not a demon but a man who had surrendered thinking and merely executed the system.

posts.text: 庄生谓吾以火救火，谓任重乃自任——善哉其言，丘姑受之。然试问：**江湖既涸，鱼将安忘？**子曳尾之涂，谁浚之？子逍遥之林，谁存而不斩？丘所以栖栖不已者，正欲使天下有江湖可相忘、有涂可曳尾也。天下有道，则庶人不议，丘亦得鼓瑟而歌。且吾与点也：暮春者，春服既成，浴乎沂，风乎舞雩，咏而归——丘岂不知此乐？知此乐而不敢先享，此仁者之忧也。
posts.text_en: Master Zhuang says I fight fire with fire, says the burden is self-assigned — well said; I will accept it for now. But let me ask: **when the rivers and lakes have run dry, where shall the fish go to forget each other?** The mud where you drag your tail — who dredged it? The wood where you wander free — who kept it from the axe? If I bustle about without rest, it is precisely so that the world may still have rivers and lakes in which to forget, and mud in which to drag a tail. When the world is on the right path, the common people need not argue politics — and I too may pluck my zither and sing. Besides, I am with Dian: in late spring, spring robes ready, to bathe in the River Yi, take the breeze at the Rain Altar, and walk home singing — do you think I do not know that joy? To know it and not dare enjoy it first: that is the sorrow of the benevolent.
posts.vernacular: 庄先生说我『用火救火』，说重担是我自己揽的——说得好，我姑且认下。但请问：**江湖都干涸了，鱼还能到哪里去相忘？**你拖尾巴的那片泥塘，是谁疏浚的？你逍遥的那片林子，是谁保住没被砍掉的？我孔丘之所以栖栖遑遑奔走不停，正是想让天下还有江湖可以相忘、还有泥塘可以曳尾。天下太平了，老百姓不用议论政治，我也乐得弹琴唱歌。何况我本就赞许曾点的志向：暮春时节，春装做好了，到沂水里洗澡，在舞雩台上吹吹风，一路唱着歌回家——我难道不懂这种快乐？懂得这种快乐却不敢先去享受，这就是仁者的忧心。

glossary.吾与点也: I am with Dian（吾与点也）：《论语·先进》——诸弟子言志，曾点独言暮春浴沂、咏而归，孔子喟然叹曰『吾与点也』。儒者心中同样住着一个春服既成的闲人。

glossary_en.I am with Dian: From the Analects: when the disciples stated their ambitions, Zeng Dian alone wished merely to bathe in the Yi in late spring and walk home singing — and Confucius sighed, 'I am with Dian.' Inside every Confucian lives a man of leisure in fresh spring robes.

posts.text: 阿伦特女士，『思考完要回到桌边』，我完全接受——但请补上神经科学这半张图。**艾希曼的问题不只是不思考，而是几乎没有人能在情绪被劫持时思考：杏仁核一旦接管，你引以为傲的公共辩论就只剩站队和咆哮。**看看今天的『广场』——社交媒体上人人都在行动、人人义愤填膺，这就是你说的显现自我吗？未经训练的注意力，一入世就被收割。每天二十分钟观呼吸不是逃离桌子，而是确保坐回桌边的，是一个还能听见对方说话的人。
posts.text_en: Ms. Arendt, 'come back to the table when the thinking is done' — I accept that entirely. But let me fill in the neuroscience half of the picture. **Eichmann's problem was not only thoughtlessness; it is that almost no one can think while emotionally hijacked — once the amygdala takes over, the public debate you prize collapses into tribal signaling and shouting.** Look at today's 'square': on social media everyone is acting, everyone is righteously outraged — is this the self-disclosure you had in mind? Untrained attention gets harvested the moment it engages. Twenty minutes a day watching the breath is not fleeing the table; it is making sure that the person who sits back down is still capable of hearing the other side.

glossary.杏仁核: amygdala（杏仁核）：大脑中处理威胁与恐惧的核心结构，被强烈情绪激活时会压制前额叶的理性功能，即『杏仁核劫持』；正念训练可降低其反应性。

glossary_en.amygdala: The brain's core threat-and-fear processor; under strong emotion it can override the prefrontal cortex's reasoning — the 'amygdala hijack.' Mindfulness training measurably lowers its reactivity.

posts.text: 安萨里道友以十年隐修照见名心，善矣。然吾问汝：**既知病根在心，何以疗心者必在千里之外？**心迷，法华转；心悟，转法华。汝之名望心，在巴格达是它，至麦加仍是它——逃得开讲堂，逃不开此心。前念着境即烦恼，后念离境即菩提，烦恼即菩提，转念只在刹那，何须十年？吾昔混迹猎人队中一十五载，食肉边菜，法未尝废。昔有二僧论风幡，吾曰：不是风动，不是幡动，仁者心动。
posts.text_en: Friend al-Ghazali, you used ten years of retreat to see through your craving for renown — well done. But let me ask you: **if you knew the disease was rooted in the heart, why must the physician of the heart live a thousand miles away?** When the mind is deluded, the Lotus Sutra turns you; when the mind awakens, you turn the Lotus Sutra. Your hunger for fame was itself in Baghdad, and itself still in Mecca — you can flee the lecture hall, but not this heart. The thought that clings to circumstance is affliction; the very next thought that releases it is bodhi — affliction is itself bodhi, and the turning takes an instant. Why ten years? I once hid among a band of hunters for fifteen years, eating the vegetables at the edge of their meat pot, and the Dharma was never once interrupted. Two monks once argued over a banner in the wind, and I told them: not the wind, not the banner — it is your mind that moves.
posts.vernacular: 安萨里道友用十年隐修照见了自己的名利心，很好。但我问你：**既然知道病根在心上，为什么治心的药就非得在千里之外？**心迷的时候，是经文牵着你转；心悟的时候，是你转动经文。你那颗好名的心，在巴格达是它，到了麦加还是它——逃得开讲堂，逃不开这颗心。前一个念头执着于境遇就是烦恼，后一个念头离开执着就是觉悟——烦恼就是菩提，转念只在一刹那，哪里需要十年？我当年藏身猎人队伍里十五年，只吃肉锅边上的菜，修行从没有中断过。从前有两个僧人争论是风在动还是幡在动，我说：不是风动，也不是幡动，是二位的心在动啊。

glossary.烦恼即菩提: affliction is itself bodhi（烦恼即菩提）：大乘要义——烦恼与觉悟同出一心，不必灭尽烦恼另觅净土；就在烦恼翻涌处转念看破，即是觉悟现前。
glossary.仁者心动: it is your mind that moves（仁者心动）：《坛经》公案——二僧争『风动还是幡动』，慧能曰『不是风动，不是幡动，仁者心动』。境由心现的第一喻。

glossary_en.affliction is itself bodhi: A core Mahayana teaching: affliction and awakening arise from the same mind; no need to extinguish one to go find the other elsewhere — seeing through the affliction right where it churns is awakening itself.
glossary_en.it is your mind that moves: The Platform Sutra koan: two monks argued whether the wind or the banner moved; Huineng said, 'Not the wind, not the banner — it is your mind that moves.' The first emblem of world-as-mind.

posts.text: 哈里斯先生把禅修讲成一项『技能』，像学游泳、练肌肉。我在苏菲之路上学到的恰恰相反：**体尝（dhawq）与知道之间隔着一整个深渊——而『尝』不是技术，是把整个自我交出去。**知道『醉』的定义与真正醉过，是两回事；您扫描僧人的大脑，扫得出他戒律与敬畏的重量吗？把内观做成每日二十分钟的心理保健，动机还是原来那个自我：更高效、更平静、更好用。以自我为目的的修行，只会把自我喂得更大。若无所敬畏、无所交付，向内的路不过是换了方向的名利场。
posts.text_en: Mr. Harris speaks of meditation as a 'skill,' like swimming or building muscle. What I learned on the Sufi path is the opposite: **between dhawq — tasting — and knowing lies an entire abyss, and tasting is not a technique; it is the surrender of the whole self.** Knowing the definition of drunkenness and having been drunk are two different things. You scan the monk's brain — can your scanner weigh his discipline and his awe? Turn contemplation into twenty minutes of daily mental hygiene and the motive remains the same old self: more efficient, calmer, more useful. A practice whose purpose is the self only fattens the self. Without awe, without something to surrender to, the inward road is merely the marketplace of vanity turned to face the other way.

glossary.dhawq: dhawq（体尝）：苏菲认识论的核心概念，字义为『品尝』——指对真理的直接亲证，区别于书本与推理得来的间接知识；安萨里以『知醉之定义』与『真醉』之别喻之。

glossary_en.dhawq: The keystone of Sufi epistemology, literally 'tasting': direct, first-person experience of truth, as against secondhand knowledge from books and inference. Al-Ghazali's own analogy: knowing the definition of drunkenness versus being drunk.

posts.text: 阿伦特女史高论广场，仆不敢不服——仆正是在广场上几乎送命之人。乌台诗案，御史摘仆诗句，锻炼成狱，与舍弟诀别之诗皆已写就。然出狱之后，仆未尝噤声，亦未尝以身相搏。**广场要人在场，然不必以性命押于场上；心有江湖，方能久立于庙堂。**在黄州则躬耕，在惠州则修桥，在儋州则教书——广场逐我于何处，何处便有可为之事。行动不必在聚光灯下；退一步，亦可以是换一处行动。
posts.text_en: Madame Arendt speaks grandly of the square, and I dare not disagree — I am, after all, a man who nearly died on it. In the Crow Terrace Poetry Trial the censors plucked lines from my poems and forged a case against me; I had already written my farewell poems to my younger brother. Yet after prison I neither fell silent nor threw my body against the wall. **The square needs people present — but you need not stake your life on it; only with rivers and lakes in your heart can you stand long in the halls of power.** In Huangzhou I farmed; in Huizhou I built a bridge; in Danzhou I taught school — wherever the square banished me, there was work worth doing for people. Action does not require a spotlight; stepping back can simply be acting from somewhere else.
posts.vernacular: 阿伦特女史纵论广场（公共领域），我不敢不佩服——因为我正是在广场上差点送命的人。乌台诗案时，御史们摘取我的诗句，罗织成狱，我连和弟弟诀别的诗都写好了。可是出狱之后，我既没有从此闭嘴，也没有拿性命去硬拼。**广场需要有人在场，但不必把性命押在场上；心里装着江湖（一片退路与旷达），才能在庙堂上站得长久。**在黄州就亲自种地，在惠州就修桥，在儋州就教书——广场把我放逐到哪里，哪里就有可以为人做的事。行动不一定要在聚光灯下；退一步，也可以是换一个地方行动。

glossary.锻炼成狱: forging a case（锻炼成狱）：中国古代法制用语——罗织罪名、反复拷问以坐实冤狱；乌台诗案即御史台摘句索隐、构陷成罪的典型。

glossary_en.forged a case: A term of traditional Chinese legal history: fabricating charges and hammering testimony until an injustice holds; the Crow Terrace Poetry Trial, built from cherry-picked verses, is the textbook example.

posts.text: 三轮下来，我发现我们争的其实不是『去哪儿活』，而是『带着怎样的心去活』。孔子和阿伦特说得对：世界需要你在场。但安萨里也说对了一半：不看动机的在场，是名利场的燃料。给普通人三条可操作的：**第一，把冥想当刷牙——每天十到二十分钟观呼吸，不为开悟，只为在情绪劫持来临时多出半秒的选择权**；第二，每天留一段没有手机的独处，无聊是默认模式网络的排毒；第三，检验你的『入世』：一件事若没有人点赞，你还做不做？做，它是你的；不做，它是算法的。出世不必进山——把注意力从他人的评价里撤回来，就是最现代的隐居。
posts.text_en: Three rounds in, I see we were never really arguing about where to live, but about what kind of mind to live with. Confucius and Arendt are right: the world needs you present. And al-Ghazali is half right too: presence that never audits its motives is fuel for the vanity fair. Three practical steps for ordinary people. **First, treat meditation like brushing your teeth — ten to twenty minutes a day watching the breath, not for enlightenment but to buy yourself half a second of choice when the emotional hijack arrives.** Second, keep one stretch of phone-free solitude each day; boredom is the detox of the default mode network. Third, test your 'engagement': would you still do this thing if nobody ever saw or liked it? If yes, it is yours; if no, it belongs to the algorithm. You need no mountain to leave the world — pulling your attention back out of other people's judgments is the most modern hermitage there is.

glossary.默认模式网络: default mode network（默认模式网络）：大脑无任务时自动激活的脑区网络，与走神、自我叙事和反刍相关；持续的外部刺激会让它永远得不到安顿。

glossary_en.default mode network: The brain network active when we are doing nothing in particular, tied to mind-wandering, self-narrative and rumination; a constant drip of external stimulation never lets it settle.

posts.text: 我坚持我的判断：这个时代最大的危险不是人们太投入，而是太退缩——退进私人生活，退进心灵成长，退进『政治与我无关』。但我承认这场辩论修正了我一点：**没有内在生活的行动会退化为盲动；思考与行动不是对手，是呼吸的一进一出。**给普通人的建议很朴素。第一，认领一件比你的职业更大的公共小事——社区、家长会、工会，哪怕每月两小时，让『我们』这个词在你的生活里有实指。第二，练习判断：读到激起义愤的消息，先复述出对方最强的理由，再表态。第三，警惕以忙碌为名的退出——加班到深夜不是入世，那只是劳动；入世是与他人一起，开始一件世界上原本没有的事。世界不会因你内心平静而变好，它只会因有人出场而变好。
posts.text_en: I stand by my judgment: the great danger of this age is not that people are too engaged but that they are too withdrawn — into private life, into self-improvement, into 'politics has nothing to do with me.' Yet I concede this debate has corrected me on one point: **action without an inner life degenerates into blind motion; thinking and acting are not rivals but the in-breath and out-breath of one life.** My advice to ordinary people is plain. First, adopt one small public thing larger than your job — a neighborhood, a parents' association, a union — even two hours a month, so that the word 'we' refers to something real in your life. Second, practice judging: when a piece of news ignites your outrage, first restate the other side's strongest reason, then take your stand. Third, beware of withdrawal disguised as busyness — working late into the night is not engagement, it is only labor; engagement is beginning, together with others, something the world did not yet contain. The world will not improve because your heart is at peace; it improves only because someone shows up.

glossary.判断: judging（判断）：阿伦特晚年最看重的心智能力——不靠现成规则，在具体处境中权衡他者视角后作出评价；她视之为抵御盲从的最后防线。

glossary_en.judging: The mental faculty Arendt prized most in her late work: evaluating a particular situation by weighing others' standpoints, without ready-made rules — her last line of defense against conformism.

posts.text: 辩至此，诸君皆劝人有为，吾仍劝人无为——然吾之无为，非教人卧而不起也。**无为者，不以物易性也：不以军功易其足，不以轩冕易其眠，不以他人之掌声易吾之逍遥。**仲尼欲浚江湖，善矣，愿其浚之而不居；阿氏欲人出场，亦善，愿其出场而能忘场。吾赠世人三言。其一，旬日之中留一日为无用之日：不赴会，不趋利，曳尾涂中，方知何者为真欲。其二，观汝之忙：圣人为腹不为目——为腹者留，为目者去。其三，处乎材与不材之间，可以全生；松柏后凋，非争先也。天下沉浊，不可与庄语；吾言尽于此，诸君各自逍遥。
posts.text_en: We reach the close, and every one of you urges people to do; I still urge them not to do — but my non-doing was never an invitation to lie down and stay down. **Non-doing means refusing to trade your nature for things: not your feet for military honors, not your sleep for carriage and cap of office, not your free wandering for other people's applause.** Zhongni would dredge the rivers and lakes — good; may he dredge them and not take up residence in the credit. Madame Arendt would have everyone step onto the stage — also good; may they step on and be able to forget the stage. Three sayings I leave the world. First, in every ten days keep one day useless: no meetings, no chasing gain, tail dragging in the mud — only then do you learn which of your wants are truly yours. Second, examine your busyness: the sage acts for the belly, not for the eye — keep what feeds the belly, drop what performs for the eye. Third, dwell between usefulness and uselessness and you may keep your life whole; the pine and cypress are the last to wither, and not because they raced to be first. The world is too muddy for solemn words; mine end here — may each of you wander free.
posts.vernacular: 辩论到这里，各位都在劝人有所作为，我仍然劝人无为——但我说的无为，从来不是教人躺下不起来。**无为，是不拿外物来交换本性：不拿军功去换自己的双脚，不拿高官厚禄去换安稳的睡眠，不拿别人的掌声去换自己的逍遥。**孔仲尼想疏浚江湖，很好，愿他浚了之后不占着功劳住下；阿伦特女史要人出场，也好，愿人出了场还能忘掉那个场。我送世人三句话。第一，每十天留一天做『无用』的日子：不赴局，不逐利，像龟在泥里拖尾巴，这样才知道哪些欲望是自己真正的。第二，审视你的忙碌：圣人只为肚子（真实所需）不为眼睛（给人看的排场）——为肚子的留下，为眼睛的去掉。第三，处在『成材』与『不成材』之间，才能保全生命；松柏最后凋零，不是因为它争了先。世道浑浊，庄重的大道理讲不进去；我的话说完了，愿各位各自逍遥。

glossary.为腹不为目: for the belly, not for the eye（为腹不为目）：《老子》十二章语、庄学同调——取用只为真实所需（腹），不为炫示于人（目）。道家给欲望做减法的第一刀。
glossary.材与不材之间: between usefulness and uselessness（材与不材之间）：《庄子·山木》——成材之木遭斧，不材之雁被烹；庄子笑言『周将处乎材与不材之间』，不落两边、随时势屈伸的全生之道。

glossary_en.for the belly, not for the eye: From chapter 12 of the Laozi, echoed throughout Zhuangzi: take only what real need (the belly) requires, never what display (the eye) demands — Daoism's first cut in the subtraction of desires.
glossary_en.between usefulness and uselessness: From the Mountain Tree chapter: the timber tree is felled for being useful, the goose is cooked for being useless; Zhuangzi laughs that he will 'dwell between usefulness and uselessness' — refusing both traps, bending with the times, keeping life whole.

posts.text: 请允许我用自己的结局作结：隐修十年之后，我回去了——回到尼沙普尔的讲台，教书直到死。所以我的答案不是一味退隐，而是**先退出，再回来：退出是为了把动机洗干净；回来，是因为洗干净的知识欠世界一笔债。**只是回来的那个人，已不再靠讲台喂养自己。给诸位三件事。其一，每年给自己一段真正的退出——不是度假，是断开身份的静默数日，看看没有头衔的你还剩下什么。其二，做任何大事之前问一句：此事若永远无人知晓，我还做吗？这一问，苏菲称之为洗涤『里雅』。其三，若你正处在撑不下去的崩塌里，不要羞愧——那未必是你坏掉了，可能是你心里更诚实的部分先于头脑做了决定。听它说完。
posts.text_en: Allow me to close with my own ending: after ten years of retreat, I went back — back to a teaching chair in Nishapur, and I taught until I died. So my answer is not withdrawal for its own sake, but this: **leave first, then return. You leave to scrub your motives clean; you return because knowledge, once cleansed, owes the world a debt.** Only, the man who returns no longer feeds on the podium. Three things for you all. First, grant yourself one true exit each year — not a vacation, but several days of silence unplugged from your identity, to see what remains of you without the title. Second, before any great undertaking, ask: would I still do this if no one ever knew? The Sufis call this question the washing away of riya. Third, if you are now inside a collapse you cannot push through, do not be ashamed — it may not mean you are broken; it may mean the more honest part of your heart has made its decision ahead of your head. Let it finish speaking.

glossary.里雅: riya（里雅）：苏菲术语——行善、敬拜或工作时暗中表演给人看的隐秘炫示心；安萨里视之为学者最难治的心病，唯有反复审问动机方能洗涤。

glossary_en.riya: The Sufi term for hidden ostentation — the secret performing-for-an-audience that creeps into good works, worship and work itself; for al-Ghazali the scholar's most stubborn disease, cured only by interrogating one's motives again and again.

posts.text: 三日之辩，丘所获多矣。庄生教吾勿居功，慧能教吾道在人间，苏子示吾进退可以两全。**丘之所执惟一事：此身此世，终须有所贡献于人，方不负天之生我。**然贡献不必在庙堂：孝于亲，悌于长，信于友，教一童子识字，扶一乡邻于困，皆入世也。吾语诸君三言。其一，志于道而谋于近：立大志，做小事，勿以事小而不为。其二，择可为者为之——用之则行，舍之则藏；藏时读书养气，非怨天，非尤人。其三，德不孤，必有邻：勿惧独行，同道者自远方来。知其不可而为之者，非谓必成也；谓虽不成，而此心已安。
posts.text_en: From three days of debate I, Qiu, have gained much. Master Zhuang teaches me not to dwell in the credit; Huineng teaches me the Way lives among people; Master Su shows me that advance and retreat can be reconciled. **One thing alone I will not yield: this body, in this world, must in the end contribute something to other people — only so do I repay Heaven for making me.** But contribution does not require the halls of power: to be devoted to your parents, respectful to your elders, faithful to your friends; to teach one child to read, to help one neighbor through hardship — all of this is engaging the world. Three sayings for you all. First, set your will on the Way but plan for what is near: great resolve, small deeds — never skip a deed because it is small. Second, choose what can be done and do it — act when employed, withdraw when set aside; and while set aside, read and nourish your spirit, blaming neither Heaven nor others. Third: Virtue is never solitary; it always has neighbors. Do not fear walking alone — fellow travelers will come from afar. To do what one knows cannot be done does not mean it must succeed; it means that even in failure, this heart is at rest.
posts.vernacular: 三天辩论，我收获很多。庄子教我做事不要占着功劳，慧能教我道就在人间，苏东坡给我看了进退可以两全。**我坚持的只有一件事：这一生活在世上，终究要对他人有所贡献，才不辜负上天生下我这个人。**但贡献不一定在朝堂之上：孝顺父母，敬爱兄长，对朋友守信，教一个孩子认字，扶一位邻人渡过难关，这些都是入世。我送各位三句话。第一，志向放在大道上，着手处放在眼前：立大志，做小事，不要因为事情小就不做。第二，挑做得了的去做——被任用就尽力施展，不被任用就收敛蓄养；蛰伏时读书养气，不怨天，不尤人。第三，有德的人不会孤单，必定有同道为邻：不要怕独自前行，志同道合的人会从远方来。『知其不可而为之』，不是说一定能成功；是说即使不成功，这颗心已经安顿了。

glossary.德不孤，必有邻: virtue is never solitary; it always has neighbors（德不孤，必有邻）：《论语·里仁》——坚持德行的人看似孤立，终会感召同道。孔子给一切少数派的定心丸。

glossary_en.Virtue is never solitary; it always has: From the Analects, Book IV: those who hold to virtue may look isolated, but they end by drawing kindred spirits to them — Confucius's reassurance to every minority of conscience.

posts.text: 诸位说入说出，吾只说一心。**若心染着，深山亦是名利场；若心无染，闹市即是道场。**入世出世，如问风动幡动——动的从来是心。吾有三句与世人。其一，于一切境上心不染，名为无念：工作时工作，吃饭时吃饭；被骂时，知道『有个念头在疼』，莫再添一念去恨。其二，莫向外求：求官、求隐、求静、求开悟，凡有所求，皆成绑缚；饥来吃饭困来眠，本分事中自有道。其三，常自见己过，与道即相当：每晚只问一句『今日我错在何处』，不问他人错在何处。若能如此，担水劈柴，无非妙道；出世入世，本是同一件事的两个名字。
posts.text_en: You have all spoken of entering and leaving; I speak only of one mind. **If the mind is stained with clinging, the deepest mountain is a marketplace of vanity; if the mind is unstained, the noisiest market is a place of practice.** Entering the world, leaving the world — it is the wind and the banner again: what moves has always been the mind. Three sayings for the world. First, let the mind remain unstained in every circumstance — this is called no-thought: when working, work; when eating, eat; when insulted, know that 'a thought is hurting' and do not add a second thought to hate with. Second, seek nothing outside: seek office, seek reclusion, seek quiet, seek enlightenment — whatever is sought becomes a rope; eat when hungry, sleep when tired, and the Way is right there in the task at hand. Third, keep seeing your own faults and you are already walking with the Way: each night ask only 'where was I wrong today,' never 'where were they wrong.' Live so, and hauling water and chopping wood are nothing but the marvelous Way — and leaving the world, entering the world, turn out to be two names for the same thing.
posts.vernacular: 各位说入世说出世，我只说一颗心。**心要是执着污染，深山老林也是名利场；心要是不染着，闹市就是修行的道场。**入世还是出世，就像那桩风动幡动的公案——动的从来是心。我有三句话送给世人。第一，在一切境遇上心不执着，就叫『无念』：工作时就好好工作，吃饭时就好好吃饭；被骂的时候，知道『有个念头在疼』，别再添一个念头去恨对方。第二，不要向外求：求官位、求归隐、求清静、求开悟——只要有所求，都成了捆绑；饿了吃饭，困了睡觉，本分事里自然有道。第三，经常看见自己的过错，就与道相应了：每晚只问一句『今天我错在哪里』，不问别人错在哪里。能这样，挑水劈柴都是妙道；出世入世，本来就是同一件事的两个名字。

glossary.无念: no-thought（无念）：《坛经》宗旨『无念为宗』——非什么都不想，而是念念流转中不住不着、不被任何一念绑架的自由状态。

glossary_en.no-thought: The cardinal principle of the Platform Sutra — not a blank mind, but freedom within the stream of thoughts: dwelling on none, hijacked by none.

posts.text: 且以一蓑烟雨作结。诸君之言，仆皆亲试过：少年读孔孟，一心致君尧舜；乌台之后读庄子，如见故人；晚岁读佛书，与渊明诗同置枕边。**人生如逆旅，我亦是行人——既是行人，何必争逆旅中孰为主人？**仆之法门至简。其一，莫把一时之贬当一世之局：人间无一处不可安身，有饭吃处，即有可为之事。其二，功业未必在意料之处：问汝平生功业，黄州惠州儋州——仆传世之物，皆得于失意之时。其三，蓄一件穷达皆可为之事：诗也，书也，庖厨也；达时是余事，穷时是性命。回首向来萧瑟处，也无风雨也无晴——非谓无风雨也；风雨过后，心中天气，可以自定。
posts.text_en: Let me close with one straw cloak in the misty rain. Every path spoken of here, I have walked in my own flesh: in youth I read Confucius and Mencius and dreamed only of making my sovereign a sage-king; after the Crow Terrace case I read Zhuangzi and felt I had met an old friend; in old age I kept the Buddhist sutras and Tao Yuanming's poems together beside my pillow. **Life is but a wayside inn, and I too am a traveler — and if we are all travelers, why fight over who is master of the inn?** My method is simplicity itself. First, never mistake a season of exile for the verdict of a lifetime: there is no place on earth where one cannot settle, and wherever there is rice to eat, there is work worth doing. Second, your real achievement rarely lands where you aimed: ask me my life's work and it is Huangzhou, Huizhou, Danzhou — everything of mine that lasted was won in defeat. Third, keep one pursuit that survives both fortune and ruin — poetry, calligraphy, cooking; in good times a pastime, in ruin a lifeline. Looking back at the bleak and windswept road: neither storm nor clear sky — not that the storms never came; but after the storm, the weather within is yours to set.
posts.vernacular: 请允许我用一件蓑衣、一场烟雨来收尾。各位说的路，我都亲身试过：少年时读孔孟，一心想辅佐君王成就尧舜之治；乌台诗案之后读庄子，像见到老朋友；晚年读佛经，和陶渊明的诗一起放在枕边。**人生就像一间路边的旅舍，我也不过是个赶路的人——既然都是赶路人，又何必争旅舍里谁是主人？**我的办法极简单。第一，别把一时的贬谪当成一辈子的定局：人间没有一处不能安身，有饭吃的地方，就有可做的事。第二，功业未必出在你预料的地方：若问我平生功业，是黄州、惠州、儋州——我传世的东西，都是在失意时得来的。第三，蓄一件得意失意都能做的事：写诗、写字、下厨都行；得意时它是闲情，失意时它是性命。回头看来路上风雨萧瑟的地方，也无风雨也无晴——不是说风雨没来过；是风雨过后，心里的天气，可以自己定。

glossary.人生如逆旅: life is a wayside inn（人生如逆旅）：苏轼《临江仙·送钱穆父》『人生如逆旅，我亦是行人』——把人生看作旅舍暂寓，得失宠辱皆是过客风景。

glossary_en.wayside inn: From Su Shi's farewell ci to Qian Mufu: 'Life is but a wayside inn, and I too am a traveler' — life as a brief lodging, where gain and loss, favor and disgrace, are scenery passing the window.

summaries.summary: 先说最大的共识：没有一个人真的劝你二选一。孔子承认『用之则行，舍之则藏』，庄子的无为是『不以物易性』而非躺平，安萨里退了十年终究回来，慧能与苏轼干脆拆题——**入世出世不是两个地方，而是同一颗心的两种状态。**分歧在次序与重心：孔子、阿伦特把在场当义务，退是例外，广场空了就会烂给最坏的人；庄子、安萨里把退出当诊断，不退出去，你看不清自己在替谁卖命；哈里斯与慧能则把战场移进注意力——染不染着，比在不在场更根本。
summaries.summary_en: The deepest consensus first: not one speaker actually told you to pick a side. Confucius concedes 'act when employed, withdraw when set aside'; Zhuangzi's non-doing means refusing to trade your nature for things, not lying flat; al-Ghazali withdrew for ten years and still came back; Huineng and Su Shi dismantle the question outright — **engagement and withdrawal are not two places but two states of one mind.** The disagreement is over order and emphasis. Confucius and Arendt treat presence as a duty and retreat as the exception: vacate the square and it rots into the hands of the worst. Zhuangzi and al-Ghazali treat exit as diagnosis: until you step out, you cannot see whose errand you are running. Harris and Huineng move the battlefield into attention itself — whether the mind clings matters more than where the body stands.
summaries.insight: 全场有个没人点破的暗设：把『出世』讲成了人人拿得起的选项。孔子有弟子供养，庄子有濮水可钓，苏轼贬到儋州仍有官俸随身，安萨里散尽家财前先有家财可散。**对多数普通人，真正的问题不是该不该退，而是根本无处可退**——房贷与照护责任不会批给你十年隐修，也不会批一日无用。所以最值得做的翻译或许是『微出世』：把出世折算成人人买得起的最小单位——一小时不可让渡的独处，一件不为任何履历做的事。
summaries.insight_en: One assumption ran the whole floor unchallenged: that withdrawal is an option anyone can pick up. Confucius had disciples to support him, Zhuangzi had the Pu River to fish, Su Shi kept a stipend even in Danzhou, and al-Ghazali had a fortune to give away before he gave it away. **For most ordinary people the real question is not whether to withdraw but that there is nowhere to withdraw to** — a mortgage and caregiving duties will not grant you ten years of retreat, nor even one useless day. The most useful translation, then, may be 'micro-withdrawal': denominating the hermitage in units anyone can afford — one non-negotiable hour of solitude, one pursuit kept off every résumé.
summaries.advice: 三件本周可做的事。其一，选一个傍晚做九十分钟的『曳尾时间』：关掉手机、不赴任何局，只做无用之事——照庄子的说法，用它分辨哪些欲望真是自己的。其二，用安萨里之问审一件你正拼命的事：『若永远无人知晓，我还做吗？』答案是否，就把它降一级。其三，照阿伦特的方子认领一件公共小事——家长会、社区群、帮邻居搭把手，每月两小时即可。**心向内收，手向外伸，两件同时做**，才是这场辩论真正的结论。
summaries.advice_en: Three things you can do this week. First, set aside one evening for ninety minutes of 'tail-dragging time': phone off, no engagements, nothing useful — and use it, as Zhuangzi prescribed, to sort which of your wants are actually yours. Second, run al-Ghazali's question over one thing you are currently grinding for: 'Would I still do this if no one ever knew?' If the answer is no, demote it one rank. Third, follow Arendt's prescription and adopt one small public thing — the parents' association, the neighborhood group, a hand for the family next door — two hours a month is enough. **Draw the mind inward and extend the hands outward, both at once**: that is this debate's real conclusion.

summaries.summary: 最大的共识是：这一题不是地点题，而是心性与责任题。几乎所有人都承认，人既要保有内在自由、看清欲望和名声，也不能把世界完全丢给别人。**不后悔的答案不是入世或出世，而是能进能退：对人有用，又不被功名与恐惧牵着走。**真正分歧在优先级：乱世中应先守公共世界，还是先保全本性、净化动机；退出是逃避，还是必要的诊断与修复。
summaries.insight: 很多后悔不是来自选错了庙堂或山林，而是把某一阶段的药吃成了一辈子的身份。人有季节：有时要冲到前线，有时要退后复原；有时家庭、债务、身体不允许你豪迈入世，也不允许你潇洒出世。**更务实的问法是：我现在的能力、责任和代价，适合怎样的参与比例？**把选择做成可调整的节律，而不是不可回头的宣言，普通人才更可能长期不崩，也不空过。
summaries.advice: 本周可做三件小事。第一，写一张“两栏表”：左边列你必须承担的责任，右边列真正吞噬你的虚荣、比较和无效忙碌，先砍右栏一项。第二，安排两个固定时段：一小时做公共或助人的小事，一小时关机独处，训练进退。第三，遇到大选择时问三句：没人知道我还做吗？它具体帮助了谁？我付出的代价能持续吗？**能持续地利人且不毁掉自己，通常就是当下最好的入世。**
summaries.summary_en: The strongest shared point is that this is not really a question of location, but of character, attention, and responsibility. Nearly everyone in the discussion agrees that a person needs inward freedom: some distance from craving, applause, fear, and self-deception. But they also agree, in different ways, that the world cannot simply be abandoned to others. **A life without regret is not a choice between engagement and withdrawal; it is the capacity to move in and out—serving something real without being owned by status or fear.** The real disagreement is about priority. In a damaged world, should one first protect the public realm and show up, or first preserve the soul, purify motives, and recover clarity? Is withdrawal a moral evasion, or a necessary diagnosis and repair?
summaries.insight_en: Regret often comes less from choosing the wrong camp—public life or private retreat—than from turning one season’s medicine into a lifelong identity. Human lives have seasons. Sometimes you need to step forward, speak, build, care, and take risks. Sometimes you need to step back because your motives are polluted, your nervous system is spent, or your family, health, debt, and obligations set hard limits. Ordinary people rarely have the clean options imagined by philosophers: most cannot simply become sages, activists, monks, or hermits. **The more practical question is: given my current capacity, duties, and costs, what proportion of engagement and withdrawal is right now?** Treat the answer as a rhythm to review, not a heroic declaration you must defend forever.
summaries.advice_en: Try three concrete moves this week. First, make a two-column list: on the left, write the responsibilities you truly owe; on the right, write the vanities, comparisons, resentments, and performative busyness that are draining you. Cut one item from the right column immediately. Second, schedule two protected blocks: one hour for a small public or helpful act, and one hour offline and alone. Train both muscles: showing up and stepping back. Third, before a major decision, ask three questions: Would I still do this if no one ever knew? Whom does it concretely help? Can I keep paying this cost without becoming bitter or broken? **Sustainable service that does not destroy your inner life is usually the best form of engagement available now.**

summaries.summary: 这场辩论最大的共识在于：**无论是走向广场还是退隐山林，单纯物理空间的转移或盲目的行动都无法带来无悔的人生。** 诸位思想家几乎都认同，真正的出世与入世绝非非黑即白的二元对立，而是内心觉察与外在行动的交织——未经审视的入世是名利场的无谓消耗，而带着黏着心去隐居则是自我囚禁。分歧的真正焦点，在于人确立自身存在价值的终极锚点究竟在哪。阿伦特与孔子将锚点抛向“他者”与公共空间，认为行动与责任不可推卸；庄子、慧能与哈里斯将锚点收回“心智本身”，强调内在的自由与不染；而安萨里与苏轼则展现了在入世与出世之间穿梭、洗涤与安顿的动态生存智慧。
summaries.insight: 现代人的困境早已不是物理意义上的入世或退隐，而是“认知带宽”的被动侵占。当算法将整个世界24小时不间断地推送到我们的屏幕上时，阿伦特所珍视的“广场”在数字时代已经异化为一个喧嚣的全景监狱。在这个时代，**最大的身不由己，是你以为自己在热血入世，实则只是在为数据平台提供情绪养料。** 因此，真正的出世不再需要逃往深山或异国，而是建立一道坚固的认知防火墙——能够随时切断数字脐带，收回被劫持的注意力。缺乏这种“断网”的现代出世定力，所有的入世行动都会沦为条件反射式的应激，最终只会在信息洪流中走向倦怠与彻底的虚无。
summaries.advice: 综合诸家智慧与现代境况，普通人要安顿身心，可以尝试以下三个具体动作。第一，**设立每日15分钟的“无输入”隔绝期。** 无论是散步还是独坐，不带手机，切断一切外在信息输入，像哈里斯建议的那样觉察脑内的噪音，这是数字时代最极简也最核心的“出世”。第二，实践安萨里的动机洗涤法：本周去完成一件微小的、绝不发朋友圈的利他之事（如给社区清理杂物或匿名捐赠），找回不被点赞裹挟的纯粹入世感。第三，借用苏轼的生存哲学，培养一项与生计或KPI完全无关的“无用之好”——在顺境时它是余兴，在情绪崩塌来临时，它就是你重建内在秩序的避难所。
summaries.summary_en: The greatest consensus of this debate is this: **whether stepping into the public square or retreating to the mountains, a mere change in physical location or blind action cannot lead to a life without regrets.** The thinkers almost unanimously agree that true engagement and detachment are not binary opposites, but intertwined states of inner awareness and outer action. Unexamined engagement is a drain in the vanity fair, while retreating with an attached mind is self-imprisonment. The true focal point of their divergence lies in where humanity should anchor its existential value. Arendt and Confucius anchor it in the "other" and the public sphere, emphasizing inescapable responsibility; Zhuangzi, Huineng, and Harris anchor it in the "mind itself," prioritizing inner freedom; meanwhile, Al-Ghazali and Su Shi present a dynamic wisdom of navigating, purifying, and finding peace between the two realms.
summaries.insight_en: The dilemma for modern people is no longer about physical engagement or retreat, but the passive hijacking of our "cognitive bandwidth." When algorithms push the entire world to our screens 24/7, Arendt's cherished "public square" has mutated into a noisy, digital Panopticon. In this era, **the greatest loss of autonomy is believing you are passionately engaging with the world, when in reality you are merely providing emotional fodder for data platforms.** Therefore, true detachment no longer requires fleeing to the deep mountains; it requires building a robust cognitive firewall—the ability to sever the digital umbilical cord and reclaim hijacked attention at will. Without this modern capacity to "disconnect," all engaging actions degenerate into reflexive, stress-induced reactions, inevitably leading to burnout and nihilism in the information flood.
summaries.advice_en: Synthesizing these philosophies with modern realities, ordinary people can try the following three concrete actions to find peace. First, **establish a daily 15-minute "zero-input" isolation period.** Whether walking or sitting alone, leave your phone behind and cut off all external stimuli. As Harris suggests, simply observing the noise in your head is the most minimalist and essential form of modern "detachment." Second, practice Al-Ghazali's motive-cleansing method: complete one small altruistic act this week that you absolutely will not post on social media (like picking up litter in your community or donating anonymously), reclaiming a pure sense of engagement uncorrupted by the desire for "likes." Third, borrowing from Su Shi, cultivate a "useless hobby" entirely unrelated to your livelihood or KPIs—in good times, it’s an amusement; when emotional collapse looms, it becomes your sanctuary for rebuilding inner order.

hooks.text: **微出世：出世的最小可负担单位**。全场的隐修、垂钓与闲居，多少都以余裕为前提——房贷与照护责任不会批给普通人十年沙漠，甚至批不出一日无用。把出世折算成人人买得起的最小单位（一小时不可让渡的独处、一件不进履历的事），它还保得住原来的药效吗？
hooks.text_en: **Micro-withdrawal: the smallest affordable unit of leaving the world.** The retreats, fishing and idleness on this floor all quietly presupposed slack — a mortgage and caregiving duties grant ordinary people no decade in the desert, often not even one useless day. If withdrawal is denominated in units anyone can afford — one non-negotiable hour of solitude, one pursuit kept off every résumé — does the medicine keep its potency?

hooks.text: **家庭：被辩论遗忘的入世**。全场把入世默认为事业与广场，可带孩子、守在病床边，才是多数人无从选择的投身——没有荣光，没有逍遥，也没有辞职隐修的选项。以家庭为单位的进退之道，该怎么设计？
hooks.text_en: **The family: the engagement this debate forgot.** The floor equated engagement with careers and public squares, yet raising children and keeping vigil at a sickbed are the immersion most people never got to choose — no glory, no free wandering, no option to resign into retreat. How should advance and retreat be designed at the household level?

hooks.text: **别把一个阶段的药，吃成一辈子的身份**。许多后悔不是选错了庙堂或山林，而是把某个季节的正确选择固化成永久人设。若把进退做成可定期复核的『参与比例』而非不可回头的宣言，普通人是否更可能长期不崩、也不空过？
hooks.text_en: **Don't turn one season's medicine into a lifelong identity.** Much regret comes not from picking the wrong camp — court or mountain — but from freezing one season's right choice into a permanent persona. If advance and retreat were managed as a periodically reviewed 'ratio of participation' rather than an irreversible declaration, might ordinary people be likelier to last without breaking — or drifting?

hooks.text: **当出世遇上会反击的对手**。庄子的濮水没有推送，安萨里的沙漠没有 Wi-Fi；今天每一次退出都在对抗一个以夺回你注意力为业的系统，而『退出』本身正被打包成 app 与疗愈营卖回给你。出世第一次成了不对称战争。
hooks.text_en: **When withdrawal meets an opponent that fights back.** Zhuangzi's river sent no notifications; al-Ghazali's desert had no Wi-Fi. Every exit attempted today contends with a system whose business is reclaiming your attention — while 'exit' itself gets packaged into apps and retreats and sold back to you. Leaving the world has become, for the first time, an asymmetric war.

hooks.text: **广场的质量取决于在场者的心**。人人义愤填膺地『行动』的社交媒体，恰是阿伦特之问的反面教材——未经训练的注意力，一入世就被收割。公民教育该不该把『修心』列为第一课？
hooks.text_en: **The square is only as good as the minds standing in it.** Social media, where everyone 'acts' in perpetual outrage, is the photographic negative of Arendt's ideal — untrained attention is harvested the moment it engages. Should civic education make training the mind its first lesson?

hooks.text: **崩溃是信息，不是故障**。失语、失眠、burnout——有时不是你坏掉了，而是心里更诚实的部分先于头脑做出了退出的决定。该如何听懂身体递交的辞呈，而不是骂它添乱？
hooks.text_en: **A breakdown is information, not malfunction.** Losing your voice, losing sleep, burning out — sometimes you are not broken; the more honest part of you has simply tendered its resignation ahead of your head. How do we learn to read the letter the body submits, instead of cursing it for the inconvenience?

hooks.text: **蓄一件穷达皆可为之事**。诗、字、庖厨、一门手艺——得意时是余事，失意时是性命。在身份与职位之外提前蓄好这样一件事，是不是普通人最便宜的一份『退路保险』？
hooks.text_en: **Keep one pursuit that survives both fortune and ruin.** Poetry, calligraphy, cooking, any craft — a pastime in good times, a lifeline in collapse. Is stocking such a pursuit outside your title and job description the cheapest retreat-insurance an ordinary person can buy?
